text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending designation of an on-street accessible loading zone on Lauder Avenue. The establishment of an accessible loading zone will provide unimpeded curbside access to TTC Wheel-Trans service for a local resident.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate at all times on the east side of Lauder Avenue, between a point 124 metres south of Rosemount Avenue and a point 7.5 metres further south.
